submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I spread them across the three corners of the composition spread. XRD showed the same spinel-like pattern (strong peak at Q≈2.79) almost everywhere, so it could not rank candidates. Index 23 (Co-rich, Co 0.70) gave the only positive photocurrent (3e-8 A), which suggests the photoactivity lies toward high Co content.

rejected.reason: Mn-rich corner; photocurrent -1e-8 A, no net photoanodic response
Ca-rich corner; photocurrent -2.2e-7 A (cathodic/negative); XRD shows an extra low-Q phase at Q≈1.16
central composition; XRD shows only the common spinel phase with nothing to single it out; not measured for merit
